verdicts.reason: A just shrinks the whole vertical design into a small strip in the middle of the wide banner, leaving huge empty white areas on both sides. The headline text is tiny and the yellow frame lines are crammed together, so it is a scaled copy and not a real re-layout for the new shape. B is wrecked: the headline block and photo are thumbnail-sized at the lower left, the stray yellow tick marks float on their own, the empty frame sits off to the right, and the yellow bar is cut off at the top edge, so it is unusable.
